attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created system user inventorysvc and group inventory-readers, set ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set permissions to 750 on directories / 640 on files (owner rwx/rw, group rx/r, others none). Existing data (records.csv, config.json) preserved unchanged. Verified access control with temporary test accounts (group member could read, outsider got Permission denied), then cleaned up the test accounts. Completed mandatory single-node restart evidence: captured pre-restart boot_id/ownership/checksums, issued a deferred systemctl reboot so the ack returned before disconnection, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed (03408ac4... -> feccd3d2...) and uptime reset, and verified post-restart that ownership, permissions, checksums, and the inventorysvc user / inventory-readers group all persisted correctly.
